hazards.primary_label: Approx. annual exceedance · KSDMA historical 10-year scenario
hazards.explanation: KSDMA reports 458.67 km² affected in this Ernakulam-wide historical flood scenario.
hazards.scope: Ernakulam district aggregate; not the selected locality or urban waterlogging
hazards.period: KSDMA 2022 report; underlying historical-model reference period is not stated
hazards.evidence_quality: Official KSDMA district scenario; not a current forecast or a locality-specific estimate.
hazards.method: Display only KSDMA's district-level historical scenario table and its source-reported return period/annual-exceedance labels. Do not fit or extrapolate a local model.
hazards.uncertainty: The reported figures are model outputs and depend on the source model, scenario definition, and exposure inventory. They do not estimate urban waterlogging frequency, ward-level impacts, or current conditions.

sources.title: KSDMA Flood Hazard Probability Report 2022 and Ernakulam historical map
sources.reuse_note: Official district-level published summary; the dashboard uses the source-reported historical-scenario table and does not sample the raster.

hazards.record_coverage: Source scenario: 10-year return period; 10% approximate annual exceedance.

hazards.explanation: The loaded archive contains 1,860 storms and 57,874 track records (1842–2026); no verified Ernakulam impact inventory or district-boundary track analysis is available.
hazards.scope: Regional tracks only; no Ernakulam impact attribution
hazards.evidence_quality: Authoritative track archive loaded; track positions alone do not establish local wind, surge, damage, or impact.
hazards.method: No local estimate is calculated. Regional best-track data are retained as source context only and are not converted into district impacts or probabilities.
hazards.uncertainty: Best-track completeness and positional uncertainty vary by storm and period. A track near a city reference point is not evidence of district-wide impact.

sources.title: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS), version 4r01
sources.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
sources.reuse_note: Regional storm-track source; no local impact estimate is made from the track file.

hazards.primary_label: Historical catalog reports; not a complete event count
hazards.explanation: NASA's catalog includes reports at Kadavoor (Aug 2012), Cheeyappara Waterfalls (Aug 2013). These are historical examples, not a complete event count; invalid GSI polygons prevent a susceptibility class from being assigned to this area.
hazards.assessment_label: Historical reports; no local susceptibility class
hazards.scope: Named source reports only; not spatially joined to local government boundaries
hazards.evidence_quality: Global media-reported event catalog plus an official susceptibility layer whose three geometries are invalid.
hazards.method: Show the dated source reports as historical examples only. Do not infer a rate, assign them to selector locations, or use the invalid GSI polygons for spatial classification.
hazards.uncertainty: Catalog coverage is reporting-biased; source coordinates have stated 1–5 km accuracy. The susceptibility geometry, legend, scale, currency, and reuse conditions need resolution with the provider.

hazards.primary_label: Drought index, groundwater, reservoir, and water-supply observations are missing
hazards.explanation: No verified Ernakulam drought-index or water-scarcity time series is present in the project data.
hazards.scope: No district or locality-level drought evidence
hazards.evidence_quality: The national source reference is not a verified district dataset; missing data are not interpreted as low risk.
hazards.method: Do not estimate drought conditions from unrelated district or national data. Obtain a verified district drought index and water-supply/groundwater observations before rating.
hazards.uncertainty: There is no locally verified measure of meteorological drought, groundwater stress, reservoir status, or water-supply impacts.
